title: TopoThink Hypergraph Format Schema (structural-only)
description: Validates the closed structural commitments of the TopoThink hypergraph format. Vocabulary is intentionally unconstrained: any key may appear in any 'attrs' object. See hypergraph.topothink.spec.md for normative prose.

id.description: Globally unique identifier. URI, URN, or content hash recommended; bare local IDs permitted but disable cross-document merging.

attrs.description: Open vocabulary. Any key may appear; URI-prefixed keys (e.g., schema:name) are recommended.

directed.description: If true, incidences MUST distinguish role: source vs target.

id.description: Optional. When present, the incidence is reifiable — its id MAY also appear as a node's id, letting other edges reference this particular participation. Without an id, the incidence is position-identified within the incidences list and cannot be referenced by other entities.

edge.description: Must reference an id present in the edges list.

node.description: Must reference an id present in the nodes list.

role.description: Open vocabulary. Common values: 'source', 'target', 'member'. Required when the referenced edge has directed: true.
